class.name: OcgBreptoolsSubstitution
class.brief_description: A tool to substitute subshapes by other shapes.
class.description: ! A tool to substitute subshapes by other shapes. ! ! The user use the method Substitute to define the ! modifications. ! A set of shapes is designated to replace a initial ! shape. ! ! The method Build reconstructs a new Shape with the ! modifications.The Shape and the new shape are ! registered.

method.name: Build
method.description: Build NewShape from <S> if its subshapes has modified.

method.name: IsCopied
method.description: Returns True if <S> has been replaced.
